reference: The Hoplite website as rendered (hoplite-website-fawn.vercel.app) and its stylesheets (brand/reference/site-css)
method: Values read from the site's own variables (--cream, --charcoal, --line, --hex-shape, --s-*, --t-*) and the computed styles of its pages; each component compared side by side with the parts of the site it comes from. Components marked extrapolated have no counterpart on the site and extend its patterns (square frames, hexagonal actions, ruled lists, the three faces).
